name: Mandy
description:
Level 8 Highlighted Balayage

100% Brazilian Remy human hair featuring a beautiful Level 8 highlighted balayage blend with soft dimension throughout.

The highlights create brightness and movement while the balayage placement keeps the color soft, blended, and natural looking. Long layers and soft waves give her a full, polished finish.

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
